rationale: The mechanical evidence is self-contradictory: price has recovered strongly off the $7.66 low with rising 1-minute lows and support above the 9-EMA at $8.29, yet the push to $8.62 was rejected on the heaviest volume of the last five minutes, and price sits far below a session VWAP anchored much higher — with no news headline available to explain the 16x volume spike or anchor a directional thesis. A 12.5% intraday range on a $157M low-float name with a 35.6bp spread means any stop is either inside the noise or too wide to survive, which matters given only $437 of daily loss budget remains. With no demonstrable edge in either direction, standing aside is the highest expected-value action.
